_comment: EXP-001 — SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE, EXPLORATORY AND NON-NORMATIVE. Every party, endpoint, and value in this file is fabricated for illustration. It is not a conformant artifact of any standard, must not be published at a well-known URI, and must not be treated as a real declaration. Verification status is deliberately set to self-attested: no evidence model exists yet, so an example asserting third-party verification would normalize a strong claim the project cannot currently support. See PROTOTYPE.md and OPEN_QUESTIONS.md.

access_grants.purpose: Answer customer support questions using the customer's own records.
conditions: request originates from an authenticated end-user session
requested record belongs to the requesting end-user
